versions.changelog:
afrexai-email-to-calendar v1.0.0

- Initial release of the skill for extracting calendar events, deadlines, actions, and logistics from emails.
- Supports any calendar provider (Google, Outlook, Apple, Notion, etc.) with no external dependencies.
- Parses emails for hard events, deadlines, recurring events, action items, travel, and implicit scheduling signals.
- Provides a structured extraction template with confidence scoring and category priority.
- Presents detected events in a numbered list for user confirmation before creation.
- Includes duplicate event detection and customizable reminder suggestions.
- Exports to various formats (Google Calendar, Apple Calendar, Notion, ICS).
